主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. announced plans to issue C$200 million in preferred shares and redeem its Class A Preference Shares, Series 12. This move is part of the company's strategy to manage its capital structure and enhance shareholder value. The filing was made on March 6, 2014, as part of the SEC's Form 6-K report. The company is a major player in the financial services industry, with its headquarters in Toronto, Canada. The decision to issue preferred shares and redeem existing ones reflects a strategic approach to balance its capital needs and shareholder returns. The announcement highlights the company's ongoing efforts to optimize its financial position and maintain a strong market presence.
